questions.question: What is an inflection point of $f\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$?
options: A point where the curve switches convex and concave
A point where the function must be zero.
A point where the function is undefined
A point where the domain changes

questions.question: Does $f''(x_0)=0$ on its own guarantee an inflection point at $x_0$?

A nonzero second derivative is required at every inflection point

The derivative must fail to exist.
